model.name: FileUnit.indexByContentHash
model.description: After idx.put(): compute contentHash, write symlink at scenario/content/<hash>.file.scenario.json → idx.filePath(uuid). Add 'content/<hash>.file.scenario.json' to unitLinks[]. On dedup check: fs.existsSync(scenario/content/<hash>.file.scenario.json) → O(1), readlink → resolve canonical FileUnit UUID.
